marker.description: Blue-headed pin inserted into the tissue

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the blue pin.
main_explanation: The specimen shows a prosection of the male perineum/pelvis. The blue pin is inserted into the erectile tissue, which corresponds to the corpus cavernosum.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located in the superficial perineal pouch?
supporting_question.explanation: The corpus spongiosum (along with the bulb and crura of the penis) is located in the superficial perineal pouch, whereas the bulbourethral glands are in the deep pouch, and the prostate and seminal vesicles are pelvic organs.
